storage: Airtight jar or the closed sprinkler at room temperature, away from the stove's steam. It draws moisture in Mumbai's monsoon; use a dry spoon. No need to refrigerate (the fridge makes it damp). Keeps for a year or more; the sulphur smell slowly weakens once opened.
substitutes: Chaat masala (a pinch more than the black salt)
Rock salt (sendha namak) or table salt, same weight

usedIn.raw: 0.5 g (a pinch, about ⅛ tsp), sprinkled with the chaat masala; no table salt is added.
